snippet.title: Grey Cloaks of Aron: The Sleeping Village - Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
"Grey Cloaks of Aron: The Sleeping Village" is a story-driven 2D detective adventure set in a mysterious medieval village. Explore locations, examine crime scenes, gather clues, talk to locals, uncover dark secrets, and play either alone or in local co-op.

Wishlist on Steam: link in the comments section
